请选择并确认原窗格的目标容器，确认前不会复制附件。: Select and confirm the original pane's target container. Nothing will be copied before confirmation.
Docker 进程或原 tmux 窗格已变化，请重新确认容器。: The Docker process or original tmux pane changed. Confirm the container again.
已取消容器选择，未发送附件。: Container selection cancelled. No attachments were sent.
附件位于已确认容器的私有目录，使用已核对用户读回验证。绑定仅在当前 Docker: Attachments are in a private directory inside the confirmed container and verified as the receiving user. The binding is reused only while the Docker process and container remain unchanged. Nested SSH or user switching inside the container is not handled automatically.
仅支持本机 tmux 中直接运行的 docker exec -it 或 dock: Only direct docker exec -it or docker attach in local tmux is supported. Use the actual container connection.
Docker 默认 context 配置在进入容器后发生变化，请显式指定 --c: The default Docker context configuration changed after entering the container. Reconnect with an explicit --context.
容器附件仅支持本机 Unix socket；TCP、SSH 或无效 Docker: Container attachments only support local Unix sockets. TCP, SSH, or invalid Docker endpoints will not receive attachments.
会话记录无效或不兼容，未启动恢复。: The session record is invalid or incompatible. Resume was not started.
工作目录或工具路径无效。: The working directory or tool path is invalid.
会话与目标工作目录不一致，未启动恢复。: The session and working directory do not match. Resume was not started.
找不到会话读取脚本。: The session discovery script is missing.
无法读取该设备的会话：需要可用的 Python 3、工具数据权限和有效工作目录；: Cannot read sessions on this device. Python 3, readable tool data and a valid directory are required. No dependencies will be installed or history modified.
工具或工作目录已不存在，未启动会话。: The tool or working directory is no longer available. No session was started.
当前工具版本未确认支持此恢复方式，请使用其原生界面或更新后重试。: This tool version does not advertise support for this resume action. Use its native interface or update it.
原终端连接已变化，请重新打开 Agent 会话面板。: The original terminal connection changed. Reopen Agent Sessions.
在此容器查看 Agent 会话？: Browse Agent sessions in this container?
将以原 Docker 用户读取工具状态。容器：: Tool status will be read as the original Docker user. Container:
若容器内再次 SSH 或切换用户，请取消。: Cancel if you entered SSH or switched users inside the container.
当前执行环境未确认，请使用实际主机或容器连接。: The execution environment is not verified. Use the actual host or container connection.
当前设备未检测到该工具。请先自行安装或检查 PATH。: This tool was not found on the selected device. Install it yourself or check PATH.
搜索项目、目录或会话 ID: Search project, directory or session ID
本窗口正在运行（点击切回，不重复启动）: Running in this window (switch back, do not restart)
允许读取本设备历史会话元数据: Allow reading session metadata on this device
仅限当前设备用户。读取有大小限制的文件头以提取 ID、目录和时间；部分格式同一行: Only for the selected device and user. Bounded file headers are read for IDs, directories and times. Some formats include chat content on the same line; it is discarded, not returned or indexed. No SDK is installed or history modified. Unknown formats use the native picker.
列表可能不完整：部分记录无权限、格式未知或超过扫描范围。可使用工具原生选择器查看: The list may be incomplete due to permissions, unknown formats or scan limits. Use the native picker for more sessions.
历史记录不代表进程已停止。恢复默认新开标签，不向当前 Agent 输入命令；不要: A history record does not mean its process stopped. Resume opens a new tab without typing into the current Agent. Do not resume the same session while it is running elsewhere.
最近最多 200 条 · 当前目录优先 · 运行状态未知: Up to 200 recent records · Current directory first · Runtime status unknown
历史读取未启用；仍可使用工具原生选择器: History reading is off; the native picker remains available
原 Agent tmux 会话已不存在，不会自动重新执行恢复命令。: The original Agent tmux session no longer exists. The resume command will not be rerun automatically.
原 tmux 会话已变化，请刷新列表。: The original tmux session changed. Refresh the list.
附着原 tmux 窗格，不重新启动 Agent；共享该会话的客户端也会看到窗格切: Attach the original tmux pane without restarting the Agent. Other clients sharing this session also see the pane switch.
读取范围为上方设备及用户；终端内再次 SSH、切用户或自定义工具数据目录时，请改: Scope is the device and user above. For nested SSH, user switching or custom tool data directories, use the actual connection or native picker.
该设备没有 Python 3，历史列表不可用；仍可新建会话或打开工具原生选择器。: Python 3 is missing on this device. History is unavailable; new sessions and native pickers still work.
自动读取所选 Agent 在此设备用户下的全部项目会话；不按启动目录筛选，不发送: Automatically lists sessions across all projects for the selected Agent and device user. The launch directory does not filter history; chat contents are not returned.
搜索会话名称、路径或完整 ID: Search session name, path or full ID
会话读取失败，请查看下方原因后重试。: Could not load sessions. See the reason below and retry.
尚未取得列表，可点击刷新。: No list loaded. Click Refresh to retry.
该 Agent 在此设备用户下没有可识别的会话。: No recognizable sessions for this Agent and device user.
没有找到该用户的会话存储目录；容器、其他用户或自定义配置目录中的历史不会出现在这: The session directory for this user was not found. History inside containers, other users or custom configuration directories is not listed here.
新建会话 / 打开目录（不影响上方列表）: New session / Open directory (does not filter the list)
{0} 个会话 · 最后活跃时间倒序 · 全部项目: {0} sessions · Last active descending · All projects
已按设置禁止终端写入剪贴板。: Terminal clipboard writes are disabled in Settings.
终端程序请求复制内容。可在设置 → 隐私与安全 → 终端剪贴板中选择始终允许写入: A terminal program requests to copy content. Choose Always allow writes in Settings → Privacy & Security → Terminal clipboard to stop these prompts. Read permission is configured separately.
允许当前终端读取 Mac 文本剪贴板: Allow the focused terminal to read the Mac text clipboard
开启读取后，当前有焦点的本机、SSH 或 tmux 程序可取得剪贴板文本（可能包: When enabled, the focused local, SSH or tmux program can read clipboard text, which may include passwords, without asking each time. Enable only for trusted terminals. Images and files still use the attachment workflow.
设置立即生效并保存；只允许前台有焦点的终端，后台请求不会读写剪贴板。: Changes take effect immediately and are saved. Only the focused foreground terminal can access the clipboard; background requests cannot read or overwrite it.
此开关与终端读写剪贴板权限独立。关闭后，多行文本直接粘贴，可能立即执行其中的命令: This setting is independent of terminal clipboard read/write permissions. When disabled, multiline text is pasted directly and may execute commands immediately. Image and file attachment confirmations are unchanged.
上一个同类型文件（←）: Previous file of the same type (←)
下一个同类型文件（→）: Next file of the same type (→)
所选文件已有未结束的移动任务，请在传输队列中继续原任务。: These files already have an unfinished move. Resume the original task in the transfer queue.
已加入 {0} 个移动任务；失败或暂停可在传输队列继续。: Queued {0} moves. Failed or paused moves can be resumed in the transfer queue.
已剪切 {0} 项，在目标分栏按 ⌘V 移动；粘贴前不会删除源文件。: Cut {0} items. Press ⌘V in the destination pane to move them. Sources remain untouched until you paste.
源路径和目标路径必须是有效的绝对路径。: Source and destination must be valid absolute paths.
不能复制或移动到原位置、自身子目录或父目录。: Cannot copy or move to the original location, inside itself, or into its ancestor.
移动完成 · 内容校验通过，已删除源条目: Move complete · Contents verified and source entries removed
复制完成 · 同机原生 cp，文件内容未经过 Mac 中转: Copy complete · Native same-machine cp, without routing file contents through Farport
移动未完成：源、目标及暂存文件均需保留，请从此任务继续，不要重新剪切。: Move incomplete: keep source, destination and staging files. Resume this task instead of cutting again.
移动目标新出现了目录；请移开该目录后从原任务继续，暂存文件不会被删除。: A directory appeared at the destination. Relocate it before resuming this task; staged files are preserved.
同机原生 mv · 暂存后安全落位，暂停后请从此任务继续: Native same-machine mv · Staging before safe placement; resume this task if paused
文件暂存目录不安全，未继续操作。: The file staging directory is unsafe. No further action was taken.
源和移动暂存同时存在，请先检查两处文件；不会自动删除任何一处。: Both source and staged files exist. Inspect both locations; neither will be deleted automatically.
移动完成 · 同机原生 mv，文件内容未经过 Mac 中转: Move complete · Native same-machine mv, without routing file contents through Farport
移动期间文件或目录内容发生变化，已停止删源；请保留源和目标。: Files or directory contents changed during the move. Source deletion stopped; keep both locations.
移动内容校验失败，源文件未删除。: Move content verification failed. The source file was not deleted.
正在校验移动内容；校验通过后才删除源条目: Verifying moved contents before removing source entries
移动内容校验通过，正在删除已核对的源条目: Move contents verified. Removing verified source entries
已完成的移动不会撤销；保留源、目标和暂存文件，可从此任务继续。: Completed moves will not be undone. Source, destination and staging files are retained; you can resume this task.
已取消。目标目录的 .swb-* 暂存条目保留，确认不需要后可删除。: Cancelled. Staging entries named .swb-* remain at the destination. Remove them only when no longer needed.
.swb-* 暂存条目会保留在目标目录，便于检查；原始文件不会被删除。: Staging entries named .swb-* remain at the destination for inspection. Original files will not be deleted.
tmux 选区超过 1 MiB，未写入 Mac 剪贴板。: The tmux selection exceeds 1 MiB. The Mac clipboard was not changed.
tmux 窗格或选区已变化，请重新选择后复制。: The tmux pane or selection changed. Select the text again before copying.
读取 tmux 选区超时；可用 Shift 拖选后 ⌘C 直接复制。: Reading the tmux selection timed out. Shift-drag, then press ⌘C to copy locally.
剪贴板已被其他操作更新，未覆盖；请重新复制。: Another operation updated the clipboard. It was not overwritten; please copy again.
tmux 当前没有可读取的选区；请保持选区后按 ⌘C，或用 Shift 拖选直接: There is no readable tmux selection. Keep the selection active and press ⌘C, or Shift-drag to select locally.
tmux 选区为空、编码无效或超过 1 MiB，未写入剪贴板。: The tmux selection is empty, invalid UTF-8 or larger than 1 MiB. The clipboard was not changed.
无法读取当前 tmux 选区；请重试或用 Shift 拖选后 ⌘C 复制。: Could not read the current tmux selection. Retry, or Shift-drag and press ⌘C to copy locally.
当前 tmux 无法独立读取选区；请用 Shift 拖选后 ⌘C 复制。: This tmux cannot read the selection independently. Shift-drag, then press ⌘C to copy locally.
